This report details Microsoft's approach to measuring energy (Power Usage Effectiveness, PUE) and water (Water Usage Effectiveness, WUE) efficiency across its 500+ datacenters globally. It highlights innovations like free air cooling, rainwater harvesting, and hydrogen fuel cells, along with regional PUE and WUE data for FY24 and FY25. The report also emphasizes Microsoft's commitment to reducing environmental impact through sustainable practices and energy improvements.
